The energy's been great — feels like a good group.
I'm here to prove I belong immediately.
Excited to show this city what I can do.

pool.question: New team, new locker room. What's stood out most so far?

options.text: How quickly guys have welcomed me in.
Everybody's got something to prove — I like that.
The structure. This is a well-run operation.
I already feel like a leader's expected of me.

pool.question: You haven't taken the field with this organization yet. What are you most looking forward to?

options.text: Just getting out there and competing, period.
Building something with these teammates from week one.
Making sure I earn the trust of this locker room.
Giving these fans a moment to remember.

pool.question: What made this landing spot feel like the right fit?

options.text: The direction of the franchise, honestly.
The people. It felt like family right away.
I saw a real chance to compete for something.
It just felt calm. No noise, just football.

pool.question: How has the transition into a new system been going?

options.text: Smooth. I put the work in before it mattered.
Still learning, but I ask a lot of questions.
I want to master it faster than anyone expects.
However long it takes — I'm building for the long haul here.

pool.question: What do you want this franchise's fans to know about you before your first game?

options.text: That I show up and do the work, every day.
That I play for the guys next to me, first.
That I came here to win, not just show up.
That they're going to want to watch every snap.

pool.question: Getting settled with a brand-new group of teammates — how's that going?

options.text: Great. I've made it a priority to connect with everyone.
It's a process, but I trust it'll click fast.
I'm already pushing people, and they're pushing back.
I want to be someone the young guys can lean on.

pool.question: What's the biggest adjustment so far since joining this team?

options.text: Honestly, not much — football is football.
Learning the identity of this locker room.
Figuring out exactly what's expected of me here.
Getting used to the target that comes with a new name.
